## Data Collection

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-study-flow
%%| fig-cap: Schematic representation of data collection process

flowchart TD
A[Obtaining informed consent<br/>Screening of participants]
B[Assessment of eligibility criteria]
X[Not enrolled]
C[Enrollment in the study]
D[Baseline data collection<br/>and randomization]
D1[Group A]
D2[Group B]
E[Intraoperative data collection]
F[Postoperative assessment<br/>Data collection and entry]

A --> B
B -->|Eligible| C --> D
B -->|Not eligible| X
D --> D1 --> E --> F
D --> D2 --> E
```
